rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: full text not accessible for target record). The record metadata specifies Rosalina Palanca-Tan (2015), 'Unraveling Sanitation and Sewerage Concerns in a Developing Country Metropolis: The Case of Metro Manila, Philippines', whereas the retrieved PDF full text is an entirely different paper: Oluwadare Joshua Oyebode (2018), 'A Comparative Assessment of Water Corporations in Nigeria with Water Management in a Typical Developed Country', European Journal of Advances in Engineering and Technology, 5(8): 535-542. Per mandatory screening rules, eligibility cannot be guessed from the metadata title alone, so both decision and plain_criterion2_decision are set to cannot_tell with exclusion_code NONE until the correct full text is retrieved.
